complaint: Xfinity (or I guess Comcast, whoever actually owns it) charged me TWICE for internet this month. $89.99 on June 3rd and again $89.99 on June 17th. Same account, same service. I've called twice, sat on hold for over an hour each time, and both reps promised a 'ticket' that went nowhere. I just want the duplicate charge reversed.

Hello, I returned a winter coat to Nordstrom on May 2nd, in store, with the original receipt. The associate told me my $214.00 refund would post back to my card within 5-7 business days. It has now been five weeks and nothing has appeared on any statement. I have my return slip. I would really appreciate some help getting this resolved. Thank you for your time.
FedEx says delivered. Nothing at my door. No photo, no signature. $300 of camera gear gone. Claim denied in 10 minutes, clearly nobody looked at it. Fix this.

I stayed at the Marriott downtown last weekend for my sister's wedding and the front desk manager was openly rude to my elderly mother when she asked for help with the elevator — rolled his eyes, made a comment under his breath. The room itself was fine and I'm not after compensation. I want the hotel to acknowledge it and apologize to her. That kind of treatment is not okay.

I bought a Breville espresso machine ($249) two weeks ago and the very first time I ran it, water leaked out of the base all over my counter. Tried it twice more, same thing — it's clearly defective out of the box. Breville support sent me a descaling guide?? It's brand new! I want a working replacement unit.

My Samsung TV ($600, model QN55) completely died 14 months after purchase. It has a 2-year manufacturer warranty, plain as day in the box. Samsung keeps telling me to go through the retailer, and the retailer (Best Buy) says warranty service is Samsung's problem. I've been bounced back and forth for six weeks. Someone needs to honor the warranty and repair or replace this TV.

Planet Fitness has charged me $24.99 for FOUR months straight after I cancelled IN WRITING in February, exactly like their contract demands. Certified mail, I have the receipt. The manager won't return my calls and corporate says 'talk to your home club.' Cancel the membership for real and give me back all four charges. This is theft at this point.

I've been locked out of my Dropbox account for two weeks. Their 2FA sends codes to a phone number I lost a year ago, and every recovery path dead-ends at a chatbot. All of my freelance client files are in that account and I have a deliverable due. I'm not asking for money — I just need access to my own account restored.

The SunWarm space heater I bought on Amazon last month sparked and set my curtain on fire last night. We caught it fast and put it out, but my kids' bedroom is right next door and I'm shaking just writing this. This product is dangerous and it is STILL listed for sale. I want my $79 back and I want this thing pulled before it burns someone's house down.

A people-search website called Spokeo is publishing my full name, home address, and cell number on a public profile page. I never signed up for anything and I never consented to this. I submitted their opt-out form twice with no response. I don't want compensation — I want my information taken down. I'm a teacher and I don't want students finding my home address.

I went back to CheckPoint Pawn downtown to dispute a $150 charge for an amp that turned out to be broken, and the owner got in my face and told me if I came back or posted a bad review he would 'break my legs.' There was a witness. I'm genuinely scared to go near the place now. I still want my $150 back but honestly I don't know what to do about a guy like this.

Someone has gotten into my Chase account and there are Zelle transfers going out RIGHT NOW — three this morning, $500 each, to a name I've never seen. I changed my password but another transfer just posted ten minutes ago. Chase's fraud line has had me on hold for two hours. I need this stopped immediately, this is happening as I type.

Back in March I ordered a dress from some boutique I found through an Instagram ad. $62, paid by card. It never shipped — no tracking was ever created. The thing is, I can't find the ad anymore, the confirmation email came from a noreply gmail address that just says 'your order,' and there's no store name on anything. I honestly don't know who I even bought from. Can anything be done?

Okay so where do I start. I upgraded my phone with Verizon in April, the new phone was supposed to arrive in 3 days and took two weeks, and when I called about it the support guy was incredibly rude and hung up on me, and THEN when I finally looked at my bill there's a $45 'restocking fee' for a phone I returned that they told me would be free to return, plus a $30 'premium support' charge I never signed up for. The late phone whatever, I got it eventually, and I can let the rude guy slide. But mainly I want that $45 restocking fee and the $30 premium support charge taken off my bill.

We booked a birthday party for my daughter at the Lollipop Soda Shop on 5th Street and paid a $120 deposit. The morning of the party they called and cancelled on us — 'staffing issues' — and now the owner won't return the deposit, says deposits are non-refundable. They cancelled, not us! Ten disappointed seven-year-olds and we're out $120. I want the deposit refunded.

Minor thing, but my HelloFresh box has arrived a day late three weeks in a row now — Thursday instead of Wednesday. The food's been fine, ice packs still cold, so nothing's wasted. I'd just like my delivery day actually fixed since Wednesday is when I cook for the week. Not looking for credits, just want it to show up on the right day.

United cancelled my flight home tonight and rebooked us THREE DAYS out. I am standing in the Denver airport right now with two kids, no hotel voucher, no meal voucher, and the gate agent literally shrugged at me. The tickets were $1,840 total. I need them to get us on a flight home tomorrow or refund the tickets plus cover tonight's hotel. We have school and work Monday.

I'm confused and hoping someone can explain this. I keep getting bills from a company called 'NRG Home Services' for a water heater protection plan — $19.99 a month — that I never signed up for. They've already taken $39.98 from the card I apparently have on file with them somehow? I don't even own my water heater, my landlord does. Is this a scam? I just want them to stop billing me, refund the two charges, and confirm in writing that I owe nothing.
